product.name: Pawsome Hydration Bowl 600ml
product.description: The Pawsome Hydration Bowl 600ml is a lightweight, durable feeding solution designed for dogs and cats that enjoy a clean, spill‑free drinking experience. Constructed from food‑grade silicone over a stainless‑steel base, the bowl resists stains and odors while remaining flexible enough to bend slightly when tipped. Its 20‑centimeter diameter and 5‑centimeter depth provide ample capacity for both water and wet food, and the raised rim prevents spills during active play. The bowl is dishwasher safe and can be used in the oven up to 120°C for easy sterilization. Ideal for indoor and outdoor use, it encourages healthy hydration habits for pets of all sizes.
